Maleficent.text: If Fauna is played to a location with two copies of Dreamless Sleep, only one is discarded.
If both are present and a Hero with 4+ Strength is played, Forest of Thorns is discarded first, then the Hero takes -2 Strength from Dreamless Sleep.

Jafar.text: Neither can take an Item already assigned to the other.
Triggers if an opponent has two or more Items, including Fate Items; does not trigger Fate-based Conditions.
Hypnotized Heroes count as Allies for other players' Conditions and move to the bottom of the board at their current location.
Actions are optional; the card can be played without performing them.

Captain Hook.text: If revealed first during a Fate action, both cards must be revealed simultaneously.

Queen of Hearts.text: Size priority is Enlarged → Shrunken → Normal.
Shrunken Heroes cover 1 action; Enlarged cover 3.
Do not cover actions if a Shrunken Hero is present at the same location.
Can only shrink normal-sized Heroes; cannot normalize Enlarged Heroes.

Prince John.text: Moving an Ally is optional, but the Vanquish action is mandatory.
Grants access to a covered action once; cannot be repeated if the Hero is defeated later that turn.
Power returns to Prince John and does not count as "gained" for trigger purposes.
If Robin Hood is present, stolen Power returns to the Cauldron, not Prince John.
If the assigned Ally defeats Robin Hood, the player gains 2 Power because Robin Hood is removed before the effect triggers.

Evil Queen.text: Allows an action at the current location even if it has already been performed.
Playable even without Poison, provided a Hero is in the discard pile.
Cards/Poison are obtained only after the Fate action concludes.
Can be used even if multiple Heroes occupy the location.

Dr. Facilier.text: Triggers when an opponent discards 2+ cards from hand; Effect cards and Vanquished Allies do not count.
Result in the loss of up to 2 Power.
Required Power does not need to be gained all at once.

Hades.text: Are not Allies and do not trigger Ally-based Conditions.
Moving Titans skips intermediate locations and triggers abilities only once.

Scar.text: Finishes in the discard pile only after the effect ends.
Fate cards can be both discarded, both kept, or one of each.
Prevents triggers like Ursula's Arrogance because the Hero is discarded by card effect.

Ratigan.text: The Item or Ally must be moved from the Airship's current location.

Yzma.text: Fate cards can target the deck they were just drawn from.
Yzma chooses to perform any, all, or none of the actions at the start of her next turn.

Mother Gothel.text: Triggers if an Item, Ally, or Hero with an Item is moved during a Fate action.
Mother Gothel gains 2 Trust even if she currently has less than two to lose.

Pete.text: Each Bandit played via ability must still be paid for individually.
Retrieving a card from discard is optional.
Power Play cannot resolve if Mickey is present unless his removal is part of the Power spending sequence.

Gaston.text: Extra actions from opponents count toward the four required; must wait for Fate actions to conclude before playing.
Forces the movement of any number of Allies to one and only one location.
Mandatory ability; Allies used in Vanquish return to hand.
Cannot be played if no Heroes are in the Realm.
Non-Hero revealed cards are reshuffled into the Fate deck.

Lady Tremaine.text: Heroes sharing his location are Trapped immediately; the Trap remains if Lucifer moves.
Playable even if Cinderella is not in play.
Can target unplayable cards to cancel Fate; Lady Tremaine chooses the Hero's location, but the Fate-player resolves effects.

Horned King.text: Discard a Cauldron Born from one and only one location.
Can only be played by replacing Ancient Soldiers if the Black Cauldron's power is visible.
Moves each Hero to one and only one location.
Results in the loss of exactly 2 Power.

Syndrome.text: Moves to the bottom of the Realm if a Hero takes the Remote; moves to the top and drops the Remote if the Hero is defeated.
Discard before looking at the top six cards.

Lotso.text: Applies -1 Strength to all Heroes except Woody; Rex only takes -1 if he is the sole Hero or others move away.

Madam Mim.text: Cannot be played if Merlin's Transformation deck is empty.

King Candy.text: Covers actions and prevents their use.
Can only be played at Ralph's location if Ralph is defeated with his Medal assigned.

Shere Khan.text: Multiple tokens can stack on a single action.
Requires moving all Heroes and Allies at his location.

Oogie Boogie.text: If Jack Skellington is discarded, he is treated as a Hero.
Can be played at Oogie's current location.

Tamatoa.text: Conditions based on "Something Shiny" require the action to be covered only by a Hero for certain cards like Trapped to bypass it.
If the Hook is in hand, it must be assigned to Maui when he is found.

Davy Jones.text: Heroes are limited to one token; unrevealed tokens return to the reserve if the Hero is defeated.
Strength modifiers for the Flying Dutchman's Crew and Black Pearl's Crew are dynamic based on the presence of Allies or Heroes.
Strength increase is cumulative for each subsequent Hero played and does not decrease.
Moves one and only one Hero.
Can be used to perform a covered action.
